component.name: Tango
component.summary: Japanese dictionary with kanji, examples and word lists

description.p: Tango (単語) is an offline Japanese dictionary for the GNOME desktop. It searches JMdict and Wadoku side by side, in Japanese, English or German, and resolves inflected forms to their entry with the chain shown.

ul.li: Kana, kanji, romaji, English or German; tags, quotes and wildcards
Kanji pages with stroke order from KanjiVG, readings, parts and words; search by radicals
Example sentences from Tatoeba, English and German
Names from JMnedict and the unofficial JLPT levels, one click each
Word lists with export for Anki, Kitsun and Takoboto
WaniKani: level and SRS stage on entries, known-word filters

description.p: The dictionaries are downloaded from their publishers on first use; nothing is bundled.

screenshot.caption: An entry with its meanings in English and German
A kanji page with the stroke order diagram

description.p: More dictionaries: Wadoku with pitch accent, KANJIDIC2, KanjiVG and the radical index, JMnedict names, JLPT levels and Tatoeba example sentences; downloads and imports run in a background queue.
Word lists and favourites with CSV, Anki, Kitsun and Takoboto export; Takoboto import.
Romaji input, deinflection, the tag, quote and wildcard syntax, and an FTS5 index for gloss searches.
The source model and the Dictionaries page; per-language JMdict senses lined up; an Arch package.
